method: Two separate four-round Release crossover experiments: saved pre-optimization accuracy patch versus optimized patch, and unpatched pinned upstream versus optimized patch. Summary is median of all four run medians plus full run-median range; no runs or samples removed. Ratios divide summary medians, not paired command-buffer durations.

patchApplicability.scope: Textual applicability only; no engine builds, GPU tests or performance measurements.

beforeAfter.calibration: Current reports hash normal Bayer P010 outputs for both input frames after final sequences 68 and 69, outside timing; pool/in-place hashes must agree within each engine. outputsMatch compares both frames across all runs and engines without requiring equality for intentionally different arithmetic. It is null for legacy reports that only hash final sequence 69/frame 1. This is not a comparison of every timed frame or raw 12-bit VDR.
beforeAfter.limitation: Mac single-frame composition comparison, not Apple TV playback or deadline validation. The RPU is parsed once per profile/dimensions and parameters are reused; RPU parsing and mapping-slot state handling are excluded. Per-compose LUT generation/upload, encoding and callback delivery are included in completion latency. Decode, rendering, contention and source restoration are excluded; completion latency covers composition, not the whole playback pipeline.
